topic: Sahih al-Bukhari 6094: truthfulness leads to righteousness
coreInsight: Sahih al-Bukhari 6094 describes truthfulness as a path that leads to righteousness; it is built in small, everyday honesty.

hookVariants.text: Would you notice a small lie?

selectionRationale: Most relevant and gentle; invites a check-in without guilt.

script.onScreen: Honesty starts in small things. / A daily check-in.

CHECK-IN / Did I exaggerate to make a story better? · Did I keep my word, or make an excuse? · Did I admit it when I didn't know? · Was I honest about my own mistake? · Was I truthful when no one would notice?
REFLECTION / Why it matters / This hadith describes truthfulness as a path: each honest word is a step along it. Small honesty, repeated, is how the path is walked.
Tell the truth, even when small. / Save this for your evening check-in

caption:
Honesty is mostly built in small moments nobody sees.

Sahih al-Bukhari 6094: truthfulness leads to righteousness.

Swipe for five quiet questions to ask yourself tonight.

Save this for your evening check-in.

📖 Sources
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6094 (Sahih, tr. Muhsin Khan) — sunnah.com/bukhari:6094
Full text: Narrated `Abdullah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. And a man keeps on telling the truth until he becomes a truthful person. Falsehood leads to Al-Fajur (i.e. wickedness, evil-doing), and Al-Fajur (wickedness) leads to the (Hell) Fire, and a man may keep on telling lies till he is written before Allah, a liar
